positions.title: Principal Software engineering Manager
positions.description: Re-imagining the way AI infrastructure works in Cloud. Specifically, on how we can do GPU firmware updates with the speed of light and lesser downtime for customers .. When we started this effort , we could able to update only 100 rebootful updates in a cluster and we re-architected the solution to go and blast with no scale limit.
